name: OpenTTD
description: An open source simulation game based on Transport Tycoon Deluxe.
summary: OpenTTD does not accept LLM-generated issues or pull requests, AI-generated code, or AI-written issue and comment text; violating submissions will be closed and the submitter may be blocked. AI proofreading of your own issue or comment text is allowed, and you must understand and be able to explain what you submit.

evidence.quote: Using an AI tool to generate entire lines of code is unacceptable.
Additionally, AI-generated code conflicts with this project's license (GPL v2), since you cannot truly release code for use if you didn't author it yourself.

If you submit a pull request, you need to understand what every line of code you've changed does.
If you can't explain why your PR is doing something, then do not submit it.
